detect_multiple_planes: detect multiple planes from point cloud data using RANSAC-based iterative plane regression
remove_statistical_noise: remove noise from point clouds using statistical outlier removal with configurable neighbors and std ratio
downsample_point_cloud: downsample point cloud data using voxel grid filtering with a specified voxel size
read_ply_to_numpy: read a PLY point cloud file and convert it to a numpy ndarray
plane_regression_ransac: perform plane regression on point cloud data using RANSAC to find plane equation weights and inlier indices
